Package logic

Class ReportVisitorRow

java.lang.Object
logic.ReportVisitorRow
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ReportVisitorRow extends Object implements Serializable
one aggregated row in the Visitor Report.

total visitors for a specific date and order type over the last 30 days. used to populate the bar chart in ReportsController, split by "SOLO" vs "GROUP".

part of a VISITOR_REPORT_DATA message.
